explanation: The value is 0 at D1 and GO, and it is never above 0 at D2 when an a1 choice lands rare in S2; otherwise it is highest at D2 after a2 lands rare in S1, about 5 in mid-episode (trials 40-60), 7-8 around trials 85-90 and 10 from about trial 95. At D2 after a common transition the value is 0 before about trial 80, then climbs late in the episode: a2 to S2 reaches 2-3 around trials 85-90 and 5 from trial 95, and a1 to S1 reaches about 2 around trial 90 and 3-4 from trial 96.
